dive.notes: Deco on EAN50 and oxygen. Ceiling busted & noted

findings.title: Deco ceiling violated
findings.detail: You were shallower than the required decompression stop for about 740s. Review your ascent plan and buoyancy at stops.

findings.title: ppO2 above 1.6 bar
findings.detail: Max ppO2 1.61 bar - CNS oxygen toxicity risk. Check MOD of every gas before switching.

findings.title: High narcotic depth (END)
findings.detail: Equivalent narcotic depth reached 35.5 m. Consider more helium for this depth.

findings.title: Dive computer alarm
findings.detail: Your computer logged the alarm: ascent.

findings.title: Controlled ascent
findings.detail: Ascent rate stayed within limits (peak 9.0 m/min).

findings.title: Efficient breathing
findings.detail: RMV 6.8 L/min is very economical.

findings.title: Very fast ascent
findings.detail: Peak ascent rate 25.0 m/min (limit ~10 m/min). Rapid ascents sharply raise DCS and lung over-expansion risk. Practise buoyancy control with a slow, controlled exhale-and-dump technique.

findings.title: Hypoxic gas breathed
findings.detail: ppO2 dropped to 0.14 bar. Never breathe a hypoxic mix shallower than its minimum operating depth.

findings.title: Short or missing safety stop
findings.detail: Only 10s between 3-6 m on the way up. A 3-minute stop at ~5 m is strongly recommended.

findings.title: High gas consumption
findings.detail: RMV 27.3 L/min. Work on relaxed breathing, trim and finning efficiency; check for leaks.

findings.title: Sawtooth profile
findings.detail: 3 repeated ascents/descents of 4 m or more. Yo-yo profiles increase DCS risk.

findings.title: Fast descent
findings.detail: Peak descent rate 39.0 m/min. Equalise early and keep the descent controlled.

findings.title: Short or missing safety stop
findings.detail: Only 140s between 3-6 m on the way up. A 3-minute stop at ~5 m is strongly recommended.

findings.title: High ppO2 during working phase
findings.detail: Max ppO2 1.55 bar exceeds 1.4 bar recommended for the bottom phase.

findings.title: Elevated CNS oxygen loading
findings.detail: CNS ~60.0%. Monitor cumulative exposure on repetitive days.

findings.title: Low gas reserve
findings.detail: Lowest tank ended at 40 bar. Aim to surface with at least 50 bar.

findings.title: Close to no-deco limit
findings.detail: NDL dropped to 1.0 min.

findings.title: Controlled ascent
findings.detail: Ascent rate stayed within limits (peak 15.0 m/min).

findings.title: ppO2 above 1.6 bar
findings.detail: Max ppO2 1.66 bar - CNS oxygen toxicity risk. Check MOD of every gas before switching.

findings.title: Ascent faster than recommended
findings.detail: 120s spent ascending faster than 10 m/min (peak 18.0 m/min). Aim for 9-10 m/min, and slower in the last 6 m.

findings.title: Elevated CNS oxygen loading
findings.detail: CNS ~70.2%. Monitor cumulative exposure on repetitive days.

findings.title: Decompression completed
findings.detail: All required deco stops were respected.
